text:
lisa - Accounting: Received invoice from NordCloud Solutions (EE) for Mar usage. They applied 0% VAT but invoice lacks VAT reg no and reverse-charge citation. Holding payment.

marco - Finance: Paste header please. Need supplier VAT ID or statement of export.

lisa - Accounting: Header: 'NordCloud Solutions OU, Reg: 16321098, Narva mnt 7, Tallinn'. No VAT field. Line shows 'VAT 0% (reverse charge)'.

sara - Legal: Reverse-charge normally requires both VAT IDs for intra-EU B2B. Our billing entity is Redwood Inc (US) so may be export. Ask vendor to confirm legal basis and provide VAT ID or tax residency docs.

ivor - Vendor Ops: Contacted vendor requesting reissue with VAT reg.no and phrase 'Reverse charge - Art. 194 VAT Directive' or evidence of export. Also asked for tax residency certificate if they request gross-up.

taxbot: VIES CHECK: No VAT ID found for registry 16321098. Manual review flagged.

marco - Finance: Action: hold payment, tag as 'tax_hold', wait for corrected invoice. If vendor requests gross-up, don't approve without Legal review and residency docs.

lisa - Accounting: Invoice put on hold in AP, ticket updated. Will upload reissue when received.

ivor - Vendor Ops: Vendor says will reissue within 48h. Will follow up EOD+2.

sara - Legal: If gross-up requested, send proposed calc + local refs to me.

lisa - Accounting: Thanks all, closing loop once file attached to ticket.
